protocol.seed_rule: search seed = 88000 + partition; one independent API search per method/model/block
protocol.primary_quality: validation-selected best rule evaluated once on the final held-out split
protocol.primary_coverage: up to 10 probe-separated rules under a common seed-anchored validation gate; retain only rules meeting the corresponding test anchor gate, deduplicate on test behavior
protocol.multiplicity: Holm family of 24 one-sided paired sign-flip tests: 6 task/model cells times loss superiority, mode superiority, loss noninferiority, mode noninferiority. Exact enumeration is conditional on sign-exchangeability of block differences.
protocol.interval: 95% paired-block t intervals; report raw effects, wins/ties/losses and usage alongside p values
protocol.cell_gate: Holm-adjusted p < .05 for both loss superiority and mode noninferiority, OR for both mode superiority and loss noninferiority
protocol.broad_stability_gate: at least 4/6 cells pass, covering both models and at least 2 tasks, with no cell showing a loss CI entirely above its noninferiority margin
protocol.scope: Small tasks and the fixed language/feature interface only. Repeated classification splits overlap in samples; inference is conditional on these datasets, not new-dataset generalization.
protocol.stopping: Finish every predeclared run regardless of effect direction. Budget guard per call. Retain failed and incomplete iterations in usage. API errors without usage invalidate strict cost comparisons; do not silently rerun.
protocol.external_comparator_gate: Only after the frozen method passes the broad gate, invest in full closest-framework experiments; failure against niche already blocks a broad superiority claim.

totals.candidate_count_definition: completed candidate evaluation slots, including invalid code; unfinished planner/coder iterations are separately counted
